transcript.text: Hello, I'm here to help you get ready for your appointment. Could you tell me what has been bothering you?
It's my ankles — both of them have been swollen. I first noticed it about four weeks ago.
Have you ever had an allergic reaction or a bad reaction to any medicine?
No, I've never had a bad reaction to any medicine as far as I know.
How much is the swelling in your ankles getting in the way of your usual daily activities?

It's mostly a nuisance — my shoes feel tight by teatime and I've stopped wearing my usual shoes. I've taken to sitting with my feet up in the afternoons, and it's only mildly uncomfortable, maybe a 3 out of 10.
Could you tell me what medicines you're currently taking, including any that are new or have been changed recently?

I take a water tablet each morning — it's a small one, but I'm afraid I can't remember its name. And simvastatin 20 mg at night. My amlodipine was increased from 5 mg to 10 mg once daily about six weeks ago.
Have you had any other health problems or operations in the past that we haven't talked about yet?
I have high blood pressure, and I've been told my kidney function is a bit reduced. I haven't had any operations.
Have you noticed any other symptoms along with the swelling in your ankles?
No, I haven't had any breathlessness lying flat, and I don't wake up breathless. No chest pain either, and no calf pain or redness in my legs.
What, if anything, seems to make the swelling in your ankles better or worse?
It's worse by the evening, and mostly gone in the morning after I've been lying flat overnight.
What worries you most about the swelling in your ankles?
I'm afraid it means my heart is failing. My sister had heart failure, so that's what's on my mind.
Besides the high blood pressure and reduced kidney function you mentioned, is there anything else in your past health you’d like to add?
No, that's everything — nothing else I can think of.
Are there any other medicines you take, either regularly or that you've started recently?
No, those are all of them — the water tablet in the morning, the simvastatin at night, and the amlodipine.
Is there anything else you've noticed going on with your body along with the swelling in your ankles?
No, I haven't noticed anything else — just the swelling in my ankles and lower shins.
Thank you, that is very helpful. I have put together a short summary of what you told me. Please read it and tell me if anything should be corrected before it goes to your doctor.
